camel_example: aliyun dts TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 dtsntk10k6r12v0000 --Tag.1.Key testkey1 --Tag.1.Value testvalue1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Binds tags to one or more data migration, synchronization, and change tracking instances by calling the TagResources operation
description_zh: 调用TagResources接口为一个或多个迁移、同步和订阅实例绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun dts tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id dtsntk10k6r12v0000 --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义，固定取值为：ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query instance IDs.

N specifies the sequence number of the instance ID. For example, ResourceId.0 specifies the first instance ID, and ResourceId.1 specifies the second instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
数据迁移、同步和订阅的实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html接口查询。

N表示传入第几个实例ID。例如ResourceId.0表示传入第一个实例ID；ResourceId.1表示传入第二个实例ID
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example, Tag.0.Key specifies the key of the first tag, and Tag.1.Key specifies the key of the second tag.
Empty strings are not allowed
fields.help_zh:
标签的键。
N表示传入第几个标签的键。例如Tag.0.Key表示传入第一个标签的键；Tag.1.Key表示传入第二个标签的键。
不允许传入空字符串
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag value. For example, Tag.0.Value specifies the value of the first tag, and Tag.1.Value specifies the value of the second tag.
Empty strings are allowed
fields.help_zh:
标签的值。
N表示传入第几个标签的值。例如Tag.0.Value表示传入第一个标签的值；Tag.1.Value表示传入第二个标签的值。
允许传入空字符串
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags (key-value pairs) to bind
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定的标签（键值对）列表
parameters.name: tag

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
